description: This PHP source file defines the class FunctionPrefix within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx namespace. The class provides methods to add Excel-specific function prefixes (_xlfn. and _xlws.) to function names in a string, along with a regular expression for matching functions added in various Excel versions.

classes.name: FunctionPrefix
classes.description: A utility class for prefixing function names with '_xlfn.' or '_xlws.' as required for compatibility with different Excel versions.

methods.name: addXlfnPrefix
methods.description: Adds '_xlfn.' prefix to functions in the provided string based on a regex pattern for functions added with Excel 2010 and later.

methods.name: addXlwsPrefix
methods.description: Adds '_xlws.' prefix to functions in the provided string based on a regex pattern for functions added with Excel 365.

methods.name: addFunctionPrefix
methods.description: Adds both '_xlfn.' and '_xlws.' prefixes to functions in the input string.

methods.name: addFunctionPrefixStripEquals
methods.description: Removes the leading character (typically '=') from the function string and adds necessary prefixes.
